courses.name: Aurelia Fundamentals
curriculum: Business-computer capabilities and appropriate configuration selection
Hands-on common editing, Business Tools and introductory Abacus

fundamentals_purchase_credit.dealer_reimbursement: Logix reimburses participating dealers; do not deduct the credit from their agreed margin.
fundamentals_purchase_credit.scope: Standalone two-day Fundamentals. Existing $150 vouchers for the other before-you-buy courses remain unchanged; no stacking or extension to other courses is implied.
fundamentals_purchase_credit.accounting: Reserve the redeemed credit once as promotional expense across the course and computer sale, outside recurring manufacturing costs.

launch_program.tuition_positioning: A modest fraction of an Aurelia package price; publish exact tuition and a named package comparison when commercial prices are selected. Generated pricing proposals are not approved tuition.
launch_program.teaching: Small classes, substantial hands-on time, ideally one machine per participant or pair; business tools, introductory Abacus and advice on appropriate configurations and unnecessary purchases.

services.name: Logix Computer Academy - regular courses
services.pricing_rule: $30 cheaper than before-you-buy course after proportional 40% pre-voucher contribution reduction, subject to cent rounding; no voucher. Original surcharge was $50.

services.name: Logix Computer Academy direct product sales
services.description: Order and pay at training centres; immediate collection only where stock is available. No purchase obligation. Accept Fundamentals purchase credit; participating dealers can redeem it with Logix reimbursement.

services.name: BPI Products training
services.delivery: Logix Computer Academy teaches BPI-authorised courses under a cooperation agreement; BPI retains software and specialist support. Start June 12, 1978.

introduced.event_name: BPI training and direct sales begin

services.availability_note: BPI courses and direct sales begin June 12, 1978, after the NCC premiere; this is separate from the March Academy establishment and June 5 five-city public announcement.

services.name: Logix Aurelia Commercial Developer License
includes: ability to submit products for Aurelia Compatible designation
published interfaces and affordable support/certification access for compatible cards, peripherals and monitors
third-party implementations may use licensed chips from AION or qualified independent suppliers
services.openness_policy: Basic published interfaces are accessible without mandatory certification. Developer fees cover the SDK, support and optional compatibility designation; competitors can implement compatible hardware and software. From COMDEX 1979, the separate manufacturer compatibility kit and optional support/testing services assist whole-computer implementations; the older developer registration is not a prerequisite.

services.name: Logix Artemis Commercial Developer License
includes: ability to submit products for Artemis Compatible designation

services.name: Logix custom-chip licensing / supply to other manufacturers
services.scope: All custom chips except ROMs, especially FlexiBUS computer and device controllers, are available to other computer manufacturers under individually negotiated contracts.

second_source_program.rights: Independent manufacture and sale to competing OEMs; non-exclusive; ERA CPU excluded from this agreement.
second_source_program.transfer: SMC-compatible ready-to-use masks, revisions, process know-how, known-good reference chips, wafer-test structures, test programs and on-site engineering assistance.
second_source_program.release_policy: Initial qualified sales in October; individual part qualification and volume ramp separate. video RAM is the highest-risk gate.
second_source_program.economics: Transfer/NRE funded by AION/Logix; external-sales royalties and minimum orders negotiated, not priced facts.

services.name: Aurelia compatibility engineering support

introduced.event_name: COMDEX 1979 — Aurelia+ and compatibility kit launch

includes: Ten remote engineering hours by correspondence or telephone
Documentation and test-suite updates during subscription
Extra hours, media conversion and site visits quoted separately; no unlimited support
services.commercial_policy: Optional standard agreement; implementation is not conditional on purchase. AION-funded ports, proprietary source access and OEM application redistribution require separate agreements.

services.name: Aurelia application compatibility certification

introduced.event_name: COMDEX 1979 — Aurelia+ and compatibility kit launch

includes: Eight engineering hours for review and application acceptance testing
Versioned configuration report and optional designation on passing
Failures returned for correction; additional work and incremental retests quoted separately
Relevant hardware, OS or adapter changes require scoped retesting; manufacturer supports its own machines
services.commercial_policy: Optional standard agreement; implementation is not conditional on purchase. AION-funded ports, proprietary source access and OEM application redistribution require separate agreements.

license.unit: one server, four concurrent developer sessions
license.renewal: No automatic paid renewal assumed; first-year support capped at 12 staff-hours. Further work quoted separately.
license.expansion: Additional concurrency packs planned, not priced or counted as shipping offers.

delivery.note: One combined package; do not add its client/server editions or old IDE/SDK to its cost. Development/NRE excluded from unit cost.
